pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Frightens passive and neutral creatures, but makes hostile mobs even more aggressive.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() all three Paths at level 5.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: Campfire-like particles appear around you. This ability may scare some creatures away while attracting the attention of others. $(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() all three Paths at level 5.
